remarks: Waterfront two-bedroom, with 2.5 bathrooms  Experience living by the waterfront in this bright and spacious condo! The open layout is filled with natural light and highlighted by gleaming hardwood floors. The granite kitchen with center island and stainless steel appliances is perfect for both everyday living and entertaining.  Enjoy peaceful garden views from the great room, or take a stroll along the scenic Norwalk riverfront boardwalk, and enjoy the birdlife and watching rowers from the nearby rowing club practice, or walk to nearby shopping and restaurants.  The primary suite features a spacious walk-in closet, an additional closet, and a full en-suite bath with a separate shower stall and tub. The second bedroom is perfect for a family, guests, or a home office. Additional highlights include ample storage, in-unit laundry, and private outdoor space (balcony/patio, if applicable). Ideally located near shopping, dining, and commuter routes, this condo blends modern living with a low-maintenance lifestyle.
